rating.label: Toss Up
rating.note: One of the most closely watched House races of the 2026 cycle.

candidates.name: Thomas H. Kean Jr.
history: New Jersey Senate, 2003–2022 — minority leader from 2008

elected.note: Defeated Tom Malinowski (D) by under a point, on these lines.

candidates.nominated: Unopposed in the June 2, 2026 Republican primary.
candidates.note: Cast his last recorded floor vote on March 5, 2026 and was absent from Congress for roughly three months, which his office attributed to a personal health matter. He disclosed a depression diagnosis on returning to the Capitol.

sources.label: CNN, April 30, 2026 — absence from the House
The Hill — Kean discloses depression diagnosis on return

candidates.name: Rebecca Bennett
candidates.nominated: Won the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary with about 47% against three opponents.
candidates.note: Has not held elected office. Led the Democratic field in both fundraising and polling going into the primary, and campaigned on affordability and on Kean’s absence from the House.

sources.label: WHYY — Bennett wins the NJ-07 Democratic primary
New Jersey Monitor — the four-way Democratic field

primary.caveat: Municipality-level primary returns are not published as data for 2026; these are reported shares, not a transcription of the certification.
